newsitem.title: USA: ARIAD, Genovo in gene joint venture.
newsitem.headline: ARIAD, Genovo in gene joint venture.

text.p: ARIAD Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday its unit ARIAD Gene Therapeutics Inc and Genovo Inc would form a joint venture to develop and commercialize gene therapy products for the therapeutic protein market.
The market was worth an estimated $11 billion, the company said. ARIAD and Genovo would split all costs and profits.

The venture would combine Genova's gene transfer technologies and ARIAD's gene expression regulation system, they said. They hoped to form a platform to deliver genes into human tissue, then control the amount of therapeutic protein those genes produced, the companies said.
Protein therapy now requires frequent injections. The companies said they aimed to create a therapy based on orally-administerd drugs.

Genetic material would be injected directly into a patient's muscle or skin, the companies said. This genetic material would enable the patient's cells to produce a therapeutic protein in response to a specific small-molecule drug, they said.
Afterwards, the patient would take a drug orally to achieve stable, long-term production of the protein at optimum therapeutic levels, the companies said.
